Finding F-024: potential overbilling on SKU MFG-1002, contract C-2013, customer Harborview Plastics Inc.

Facts: 4 invoice lines, period 2024-02-05 to 2025-12-05, affected amount USD 1,649.16, estimated recoverable USD 1,504.03. The latest billed unit price was USD 257.19 against an expected USD 252.15.

Contract basis: Clause A.1 (page 3) sets MFG-1002 at USD 240.00 per unit. Clause 4.2 (page 1) applies a 2.5% increase on 15 April 2024 and each anniversary. Calculation: USD 240.00 (base price) x (1 + 2.5%) [2024-04-15] x (1 + 2.5%) [2025-04-15] = USD 252.15.

Requested action (Owner: Billing Operations): verify the four invoice lines against clauses A.1 and 4.2, and if confirmed, prepare a credit note for the over-billed amount for approval. No action is to be taken until a human approver signs off."}
